question: If a² + b² = 169, a times b = 10, and a > b, find (a - b)/(a + b)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly calculate the values of the squared expressions:

(a − b)² = (a² + b²) − 2ab = 169 − 20 = 149

(a + b)² = (a² + b²) + 2ab = 169 + 20 = 189

Required Ratio = √((a − b)² / (a + b)²) = √(149/189)

**∴ The correct answer is √(149/189).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a² + b² = 169

ab = 10

a > b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e679230b1dd97ba8004d610820f82b641e4545798f8f19a051b04e7e85d44bd4.png] 

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ (a − b)² = 169 − 2(10)

⇒ (a − b)² = 169 − 20 = 149

⇒ a − b = √149 (Since a > b)

⇒ (a + b)² = 169 + 2(10)

⇒ (a + b)² = 169 + 20 = 189

⇒ a + b = √189

⇒ Ratio = (a − b) / (a + b) = √149 / √189

⇒ Ratio = √(149/189)

**∴ The correct answer is √(149/189).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities

Basic expansion: (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.

Difference of Squares

(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Relation between Squares

(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.</p
